notes.title: Future projects and DLC
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
given the positive reception of the announcement of the Love Life DLC, 
I have decided to share with you some ideas I’ve been having regarding potential other projects with characters from the Dungeon Dreams world.
Names are still beta.

- [b]Jane’s creed[/b]: in-depth story of Jane and how she was recruited by the century-old secret Thieves Guild. Action game with stealth killing and parkour. But in truth, it’s all a simulation.
- [b]Lissbeth & Bullying, the Dark Urge[/b]: visual novel where you play the role of Lissbeth and bully your classmates but have to come up with excuses to pretend that you’re the victim instead
- [b]Dungeon Dreams Tea Simulator[/b]: experience the feelings of being a cup of tea in Misaki’s tea shop. You launch the game, you see Misaki boiling hot water and pouring it onto you. No interactivity, infinite loop (release price 99,9 $)
- [b]Musa & Vantanyar on the road[/b]: point and click adventure where Vantanyar has to solve puzzles and Musa tags along for no reason
- [b]Quinn’s good business DLC[/b]: you send real money to Quinn
- [b]Dungeon Dreams Tactics[/b]: what the title says
- [b]Dungeon Dreams Magic Academy School Dating Simulator[/b]: what the title says
- [b]Sally and the Monster Tower 2[/b]: Sally goes back to her hometown in the desert and needs to reach the top of the monster tower. I’m thinking: roguelike, monster taming, town building. 

This post’s picture is the proof of concept (artwork). As always, beautiful work by Azuukichan.

Happy April’s Fools everybody! :]

notes.title: Love Life DLC
notes.notes:
What is the Love Life DLC?
It's most definitely not a secret: the very one and only stretch goal that wasn't unlocked during the Kickstarter Campaign. 
Thanks to the warm reception of the release of Dungeon Dreams 2, I have decided to work on this DLC. 
The LOVE LIFE DLC aims to add the following to the game:
- Unique post-marriage quests for each one of the available spouses
- New dialogue lines during casual dates
- New on-site dates for some characters
- New casual dialogue options for hugging and cute stuff, also waking up your spouse while in bed
- Spouses will prepare a meal to-go for you on the table in the mornings (but should you trust Lissbeth's cooking?)
- A new building in Town: The Painter's Workshop, where you can purchase a portrait of your spouse too

But I honestly have more ideas and I'm accepting suggestions. 
I haven't set a release date yet because I prefer to take my time and add as much stuff as I can/feel like, before moving on to newer projects.
But I'm already working on it and if you're interested, you can find more detailed previews, updates, downloads, and more about it, on my Patreon page.

notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone
version 1.5 is now up, with an important new (BETA) feature:
You now have a [b]minimap[/b] when exploring the Flux. The map is ONLY IN THE FLUX, and you can enable or disable it in the options, under GUI.
You also have these following hot keys
- M to show/hide (in the flux, when enabled)
- N to display bigger (in the flux, when enabled)

Also, LUCK has been revamped. This is now what it does: (taken from the in-game tutorial)
[i]Luck is used to affect the success rate of states, buffs, and debuffs applied and received.
Each time you apply a temporary buff to Luck, you multiply your critical rate. That means a x1 Luck Buff stack will raise it by x2, a x2 Luck Buff stack will raise the critical hit rate by x4.
Luck increases Critical Damage and is also used as a modifier in certain skills.[/i]

On a side note, I am currently working with some of the artists that made some character portraits a loooong time ago (Dungeon Dreams 2 is already more than 2 years old!), mostly the talented Azuukichan, to re-do some of the NPC faces. 
You will see some character changing face in these weeks of updates. It's always the same character., it's just the art that is temporary! 
[u]No new character is added with this patch! [/u]
